items.desc: From smoky chicken satay to tender rendang and a bowl of comforting laksa, Sing-Ma serves up familiar flavours with a distinctly Malaysian twist.

items.title: Flood damage makes journeys longer and costlier in Rasuwa
items.desc: Many settlements across the district have become inaccessible after the August 26 flood damaged roads and bridges. In Amachhodingmo, dwindling relief supplies are adding to residents’ hardship.

items.title: Locals alerted each other of Budhigandaki flood an hour before official warning
items.desc: Locals began alerting one another at 4:45 am, but the local police post in Gorkha released the first official warning only at 5:30am.

items.title: Torrent of black mud and rocks engulfs settlements along Budhigandaki
items.desc: Homes, bridges and trekking trails swept away in Chumnubri. Settlements cut off, tourists stranded, five people missing.

items.title: Three generations of a Dalit family denied citizenship despite court order
items.desc: A family of 12 in Bishnupur of Saptari remains stateless despite a High Court order. They lack birth certificates, access to schooling, and formal jobs.

items.title: Aviation tycoon Birendra Bahadur Basnet on why farming is safer than flying
items.desc: After a Rs25 million operating loss at his rice mill, the Buddha Air founder says better storage, distribution and bank-backed guarantees can make agriculture profitable.
